scope: Jeddah only; installed engine and shared renderer configuration unchanged.

reference.time_policy: Late pit visit establishes the fixed night environment; earlier blue-hour T13 establishes architecture, not night sky brightness.

runtime.road_lights: Ten nearest registered targets, updated every0.2s; nearest light casts shadows. Fixture power is an appearance estimate, not measured photometry.
runtime.architectural_lights: Independent fixed facade fixtures, so distant buildings cannot starve or displace the road pool.
runtime.sky_reflection: Original generated gradient imported as a native HDR TextureCube; no reference pixels shipped.
runtime.garage_lights: Four nearest registered interior fixtures in a separate pool, so the working apron and distant road fixtures cannot displace workshop lighting.
runtime.sky_calibration: Matched clear sky at normalized(.65,.15) in supplied612/628s is RGB(26,47,76)/(25,46,77); original native sky is(28,52,86). The9ae darkened trial produced(15,22,40) and was rejected. Restore the original gradient; do not reuse an older unmatched49/87/132 reading. These are rendered/video pixel comparisons, not calibrated photometry.

vulkan_workaround.on_end_play: Restore the value saved on entry.
vulkan_workaround.evidence: Same native pit geometry and camera, fixed intensity, HZB toggled independently: specialization1 leaves local light absent; specialization0 restores local illumination. Default fixture power also works with specialization0 and HZB1. Valid scene proxies and initial zero-to-positive intensity were separately checked.
vulkan_workaround.limit: Identifies a failing experimental shader path on the tested Linux Vulkan renderer. It does not establish an underlying compiler or hardware defect.

acceptance: Renderer-path diagnosis and source registration only. Final native graphics acceptance requires new packaged captures and whole-lap review.
